Markets.title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: US futures turn negative after Sept inflation data; banks stocks in focus
Markets.summary: US stock futures turned negative following the release of the September inflation data. Bank stocks are currently in focus as the markets react to these economic reports.

Markets.title: India bonds sink deeper on RBI commentary, inflation concerns
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds suffered notable losses, pushing the 10-year yield to its highest level since March 2023. The downturn was driven by hawkish comments from RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra and an unexpected rise in September wholesale inflation.

Markets.title: Dynamatic Technologies among 7 stocks hitting 52-week highs; rally up to 32% in a month
Markets.summary: Despite the Sensex closing lower on Wednesday, seven BSE 1000 stocks reached new 52-week highs. West Coast Paper Mills led these companies with a 32% monthly gain, alongside Dynamatic Technologies, Cyient DLM, and Aditya Infotech.

Markets.title: Sebi proposes market cap-based SME IPO norms, seeks public comments on regulatory overhaul
Markets.summary: SEBI has proposed major changes to SME IPO rules, including market cap-based eligibility, higher profit requirements, and revised allotment norms. The regulator is accepting public feedback on these proposed updates until November 4, 2026.

Markets.title: Market wrap:  Nestle India, Infosys, Shriram Finance, HDFC Life top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Wednesday
Markets.summary: Indian stock indices closed lower on Wednesday as investors engaged in profit-booking ahead of upcoming US inflation data. Nestle India and Infosys led the Nifty gainers, whereas Shriram Finance and HDFC Life were the top losers.

Markets.title: Tata Technologies Q2 results: Profit rises 4% YoY to Rs 171 crore; revenue jumps 28%
Markets.summary: Tata Technologies reported a 4% year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 171 crore for the second quarter of FY27. Operating revenue for the same period rose 28% to reach Rs 1,699 crore.

Geo-Political.title: Starlink restrictions affecting Ukraine's front line operations, Kyiv says
Geo-Political.summary: Elon Musk's Starlink satellite system is crucial for Ukraine's defense, helping protect its skies and guide drones to Russian targets. However, recent restrictions on the system are negatively impacting Ukrainian front-line operations, according to Kyiv.

Geo-Political.title: Pope diagnosed with lung cancer but had successful surgery, Vatican says
Geo-Political.summary: Pope Leo was diagnosed with lung cancer and underwent surgery to remove part of his right lung. The Vatican reported that he spent a peaceful night in the hospital following the successful procedure.

Geo-Political.title: Germany puts Ukrainian on trial accused of blowing up Nord Stream pipelines
Geo-Political.summary: Four years after the attacks on Russia's Nord Stream gas pipelines, a Ukrainian man named Serhii Kuznetsov has gone on trial in Germany. He is accused of involvement in the plot to destroy the infrastructure.

Geo-Political.title: Saudi employee charged with planting recording device in OpenAI office
Geo-Political.summary: A Saudi employee was charged with planting a recording device wrapped in toilet paper inside an OpenAI executive conference room. Prosecutors stated the device was discovered plugged into a USB port on the back of a television.

Geo-Political.title: Turkish police raid opposition TV station, halting live broadcasts
Geo-Political.summary: Turkish police raided an opposition TV station and halted its live broadcasts. This action is the latest crackdown on media outlets critical of the Turkish president and his government.

Geo-Political.title: Mauritius reels from worst riots in decades after woman shot by police
Geo-Political.summary: Mauritius has imposed a curfew following its worst riots in decades, which were triggered by water shortages and escalated after police shot a woman. Prime Minister Navin Ramgoolam instituted the emergency measures after multiple days of civil unrest.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course on the topic. The author achieved this recommendation without paying for advertising or traditional optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape in 2025 requires content creators to use artificial intelligence tools to stay competitive. This guide outlines the top 10 AI tools designed to revolutionize and simplify the content creation process.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: India Inc employee attrition rises to 18% in 2026; AI is changing how companies manage talent, shows new study
Data & Insights.summary: India's employee attrition rate increased to 18% in 2026 from 16.2% in 2025 despite stable salary budgets. A new study shows that artificial intelligence is also transforming how companies manage their talent.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Board of directors is expanding’: Jaishankar pitches bigger role for ‘middle powers’ in changing global order
Data & Insights.summary: Indian External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar has called for an expanded global role for "middle powers" to help navigate a changing international order. This follows a similar proposal earlier this year by Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney for middle powers to unite as the US-led rules-based order declines.

Data & Insights.title: Piyush Goyal on China ties: India is ready to rebuild economic relations, but there's a catch
Data & Insights.summary: India is open to rebuilding economic relations with China under specific conditions. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated that any renewed engagement must guarantee fair terms, business continuity, and geopolitical stability.

Data & Insights.title: Why IMF’s growth upgrade for India doesn’t tell the full story
Data & Insights.summary: The IMF upgraded India's 2026-27 GDP growth forecast to 7 percent due to strong domestic momentum. However, currency depreciation reduced its nominal dollar GDP, temporarily dropping India behind the UK to sixth place globally.

Data & Insights.title: Wholesale inflation rises to 11.39% in September on jump in fuel, food, manufactured products prices
Data & Insights.summary: Wholesale inflation increased to 11.39% in September, driven by higher prices for fuel, food, and manufactured products. Specifically, the food index rose to 8.66% in September from 7.05% in August.

Data & Insights.title: Fixing current account deficit key to stablizing rupee: BCG's Janmejaya Sinha
Data & Insights.summary: India's current account deficit is primarily driven by oil, gas, and gold imports. Boston Consulting Group India Chairman Janmejaya Sinha stated that addressing this issue is essential for stabilizing the rupee.

India.title: Video: Bikes Skid As Painted Kolkata Flyover After Beautification Drive Turns It Slippery
India.summary: Multiple motorcyclists slipped and fell on the newly painted Chingrighata flyover in Kolkata during rain. The paint applied during a beautification drive made the road surface dangerously slippery.

India.title: 'No Trains Cancelled During Protest': Delhi Metro To Supreme Court
India.summary: The Delhi Metro informed the Supreme Court that no trains were cancelled during recent protests on October 10, 2026. A full schedule of 271 trains and 4,157 trips operated normally across the network that day.

India.title: "Why Are You Ruining The Country?": CJP's Abhijeet Dipke Heckled At Airport
India.summary: Content Creator and Journalist Protection (CJP) member Abhijeet Dipke was heckled at an airport upon returning to the capital. During his return, Dipke criticized the central government regarding the five-day judicial custody of his comrades, Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das.

India.title: IIM Ahmedabad Launches Blended MBA In Business Analytics And AI For 2027-29 Batch, Check Details
India.summary: IIM Ahmedabad has launched a two-year blended MBA program in Business Analytics and Artificial Intelligence aimed at working professionals and entrepreneurs. The program details include specific requirements for eligibility, admission dates, fees, and the selection process.

India.title: In Meerut Blue Drum Murder, Judge Cites The Gita While Awarding Death Sentence
India.summary: An Indian court sentenced a person to death for the Meerut "Blue Drum Murder" of Saurabh Rajput. The judge cited the Bhagavad Gita and Mahabharata, stating that *dharma* requires punishing wrongdoers.

India.title: 590 Days After Blue Drum Was Sealed, Meerut Murder Ends In Death Sentences
India.summary: A Meerut court sentenced Muskaan Rastogi and her lover Sahil Shukla to death for the murder of her husband, Merchant Navy officer Saurabh Rajput. The victim's body was found hidden inside a sealed blue drum 590 days before the sentencing.

General.title: Starlink network restrictions in Ukraine related to political situation, Zelensky aide says
General.summary: A Zelensky aide stated that Starlink network restrictions in Ukraine are tied to the current political situation. Elon Musk's satellite system is used by Kyiv to protect Ukrainian airspace and guide drones toward Russian targets.

General.title: Watch: Block of flats in ruins after Russian strikes on Ukraine
General.summary: Overnight Russian strikes on Kyiv left a block of flats in ruins and killed at least three people. BBC Ukraine Correspondent Dan Johnson reported on the destruction from the capital.

General.title: Family pays tribute to 'warm and engaging' man killed in tiger attack
General.summary: William Chapman was killed by a tiger after entering its enclosure at Yorkshire Wildlife Park. His family has paid tribute to him, describing him as a warm and engaging man.

General.title: Burnham had two hospitality dinners with Man City chairman, deleted records show
General.summary: Deleted records show that Andy Burnham attended two hospitality dinners with Manchester City's chairman. This revelation increases political pressure on the prime minister following the club's Premier League rule breaches.

General.title: One stolen every four minutes - inside the police battle against vehicle thieves
General.summary: Car thieves in the UK are stealing a vehicle every four minutes using increasingly sophisticated methods. Police officers told the BBC they are overstretched and struggling to keep pace with these criminals.

General.title: Watch: BBC joins police on front line against car theft
General.summary: Investigations reporter NJ Convery has been out on a nighttime hunt for vehicle thieves.
